title: Documents Show TDCJ Denied Visitation Request Involving Treasurer Candidate Liza Pena and Juan David Ortiz
excerpt: Webb County Treasurer candidate Liza Janette Pena, author of a book about Juan David Ortiz, is named in prison-correspondence documents showing a visitation request was not granted.
content:
Webb County Treasurer candidate Liza Janette Pena, the Republican nominee in Tuesday's election, is the author of Border Patrol Serial Killer: Conversations with Juan David Ortiz, based on her attendance at Ortiz's trial and conversations with him in prison.

Documents circulated on social media show two prison-correspondence records.

A Texas Department of Criminal Justice letter dated July 16, 2026, addressed to Liza Pena, states that correspondence concerning visitation privileges with inmate Juan Ortiz, at the Ramsey Unit, was reviewed by the Director's Review Committee, and that the committee decided not to grant the request — Pena's name will not be added to the list of approved visitors for Ortiz at this time. The letter states a written request may be submitted again after six months.

A handwritten letter dated May 3, 2023, from Juan David Ortiz to the Director's Review Committee, thanks the committee for adding Liza J. Pena to his negative mail list, and asks that her phone numbers be removed from his approved call list, stating his attorney advised him not to communicate with her.

Webb Watch 956 has not independently confirmed the authenticity of these documents with TDCJ, and the documents alone do not establish the nature of Pena's relationship with Ortiz beyond her documented work as the author of a book about him. Audio recordings attributed to Ortiz, cited in social-media posts, have not been independently verified by Webb Watch 956 and are not relied on here.

Pena's opponent in the Treasurer race is Esteban Rangel. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

Sources: Texas Department of Criminal Justice letter dated July 16, 2026, as circulated; Ortiz letter dated May 3, 2023, as circulated; book authorship as documented in prior reporting on Pena's book.
